dialogues.speaker: Macuahuitl
dialogues.text: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Welcome to "Asha's Treasure Trove"! We sell all sorts of interesting toys and souvenirs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are there any other stores worth visiting around here?

dialogues.speaker: Macuahuitl
dialogues.text: Every store here is special. You can head down to the Shoal's Haven restaurant for a bite, or try some drinks at Me & Dew and The Dewdrop on Tete Isle.

dialogues.speaker: Macuahuitl
dialogues.text: But if there's one store you can give a miss, it's "Puff-Up Pauldrons." Trust me, my uncle runs that place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you two not get along?

dialogues.speaker: Macuahuitl
dialogues.text: Oh, we get along just fine. It's just that talking to him can be a little... exhausting.

dialogues.speaker: Macuahuitl
dialogues.text: He always says my muscles are smaller than his brain — but in reality, it's the opposite... I mean, he even manages to get the resort's slogan backwards!

dialogues.speaker: Macuahuitl
dialogues.text: Haven't you seen them on your way here? They're the cute little guys that jiggle and wiggle around as they move. Everyone says they're the symbol of summer at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort.

dialogues.speaker: Macuahuitl
dialogues.text: Rumor has it that the word "Asha" has other meanings in the local language. Unfortunately, I don't know much about that...
